notes.title: Patch Incoming 3/5
notes.content:
Hey everyone. 

Just a really quick note to let you know that we have a small patch incoming on Sunday 5th March to fix a number of small bugs. We'll provide full patch notes on Sunday but just a quick summary of a few of the things we're aware of that we're patching;

- Sprite errors (anime girl showing instead... sorry) 
- End CGs not unlocking on some routes 
- Small typos/inconsistencies

Thankfully nothing game-breaking, so we're happy not to rush this patch and our beta tester is doing a final run-through to catch anything additional. If anyone has seen anything else you think is worth us looking into please feel free to comment below and we'll investigate. 

Also thank you for the support since we completed the game, we're very humbled and appreciative that a lot of you still had such an open mind after the development issues.

notes.title: Errant Kingdom: Part Five - Out now!
notes.content:
In our penultimate update, enjoy the (relative) calm before the storm as you visit wintery Auduryn. Words are your weapon, wield them wisely... 

[b]UPDATE NOTES[/b]

- This update brings our total word count to 403,325k

- This is the penultimate update! Our next update in two weeks' time will be our epic finale

[b]PATCH NOTES (FIXES)[/b]

[b]AMBASSADOR ROUTE [/b]

- The end of the previous update was looping the throne room scene after the end screen had finished displaying. Now fixed. If you saved at the end screen this shouldn’t give you any issues.

- Due to a variable being misdefined, if you entered the Raiden & Lucien poly route via Raiden’s romance you will need to replay the previous update from the menu choice, "Lucien would be very upset," in the castle gardens to ensure your Raiden & Lucien poly route triggers in future updates. 

[b]KNIGHT ROUTE[/b]

- A line of text introducing Lucien to the scene in Maja’s atrium was missing, this is now added.

- A repeated block of text has been deleted from the scene where you either speak to Roux or Erik underneath the tree. There was also a line referring to Erik being present in Roux’s romance route which has now been removed.

- Due to a variable being misdefined, if you entered the Raiden & Lucien poly route via Raiden’s romance you will need to replay the previous update from the menu choice, "As much as you like Lucien?" in the market to ensure your Raiden & Lucien poly route triggers in future updates. 

[b]NOMAD ROUTE[/b]

- An error where, in the Erik romance route, a variable for a menu option in his cabin was not defined correctly and may have produced an error screen. This is now fixed.

notes.title: Errant Kingdom Part Four: Out Now
notes.content:
[b]Errant Kingdom Chapter Five: Devil's Backbone[/b]

[i]A new dawn after a strange night, and you don't wake alone. It's time for your paths to converge under the watchful eye of the Gods.[/i]

[b]UPDATE NOTES[/b]

- Romance routes are here (all 24 of them + our three no-romance routes) 
- Poly and Ace flirt buttons are now active (apologies these weren't added sooner, I do all the coding myself and required some assistance)
- To enter a poly romance route (Maja & Erik or Rai & Luci) please utilize the poly flirt button when it appears during this chapter
- This update brings our total wordcount to 343,325k and our total CG count to 45 

[b]FIXES FOR ERRORS FROM LAST UPDATE[/b]

- Some save names were incorrectly labeled as 'Four' instead of 'Three,' this has been fixed but if you want your Part Three saves to be correctly labeled you will need to replay and redo your saves
- Repeated line deleted in Raiden's Nomad romance route 
- Someone requested that we add an 'auto-forward' option to the quick menu and this is now available (thank you to the person on the discussion board who helped me with the code for this!) 

Fortnightly updates will resume once again after this update. We are now caught-up to where we were with the previously released Unity version and all future chapters will be new content. We only have three more chapters left until the game is completed. See you next time, and enjoy.

notes.title: Errant Kingdom Part Two: Out Now + Update Notes
notes.content:
[i]There’s something new in Novus, something different, and that something isn’t you.  There'll be no rest for the wicked, especially not when you keep sticking your nose where it doesn't belong...[/i]

Part Two consists of Chapter Two + Three and contains 115,011k words and 22 CGs, bringing our current total word count to 218,011 and our CG total to 37. 

We have also added achievements with this update and will add more with each subsequent update (trying to avoid future spoilers by uploading them all in one go!). 

[b]NOTE: as of 03:06am GMT on 01/07 we've pushed a small update/patch to fix a small error at the end of the Nomad route where the game was looping back to a previous scene post-ending card. This is now fixed, please update your game! [/b]

We're happy to have stuck to our previous promise of releasing updates on a roughly fortnightly basis despite the team having time off over Christmas and will continue to strive to stick to this. The remaining three parts of the game will be released [b]roughly[/b] on a fortnightly basis, with the aim to have the full game released by the end of February 2023. If this schedule changes due to any unforeseen circumstances, we will let you know. 

These releases should look as follows;

Part Three: Chapter Four + Five
Part Four: Chapter Six + Seven
Part Five: Finale

Please remember that Errant Kingdom has been fully ported into a new engine (from Unity > Ren'py) due to a large number of players experiencing issues with the previous version and some being unable to play entirely. We are confident everyone should now be able to play on any system without issue.

See you soon with Part Three. Enjoy!

notes.title: July Progress Update!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Hope you're all doing well. We have some fun things to show you this time around! While editing and finalizing the final chapters of all three routes, we realized that we wanted to add a few more CGs to the game to give it that extra 'oomph.' After starting work on Call Me Under which has a more cinematic style/approach when it comes to our visuals, so where we have a little more freedom (and all-important extra time) finishing up EK without any strict deadlines, we figured it was the perfect time to add things. 

Things we're adding/working on! 

[b]Race selection tarots[/b]

The first thing we wanted to add was more of those beautiful tarot cards that our wonderful artist Lennox did for the character selection. We decided that the race selection would be the perfect place to flex Len's art so we've included additional tarots for The Leathan and The Human at the character 'creation' stage, which makes this starting point a little more interesting and interactive. We'll also be adding some more information about those races so you can make a more informed decision on who you would like to play as, similar to the information you get when selecting your role of Knight, Nomad, or Ambassador. 

[b]New key art[/b]

We were looking back at the key art that we created back in June 2019 (!!!) and, while it's still obviously super beautiful, we wanted to give it a well-deserved update so it feels more recent and fitting with the rest of our artwork. Anna has been drafting some sketches and we're really excited to reveal the final product upon release. It's going to be extremely sexy and fit for a movie poster. 

[b]Leathan improvements[/b]

One major piece of feedback we had from the released chapters was that people felt like the game was lacking enough unique dialogue for those players who chose the Leathan race. With Roux being one of our love interests/main characters, the topic of the Fae is brought up often, and I think it was both an oversight on our part and also a little bit of corner-cutting with our tight deadlines (in the interest of being brutally honest!). So we've gone back and are taking steps to ensure this isn't something that we feel like we half-arsed this time around. We hope this improvement is noticed and that you enjoy the extra little touches for your Leathan character that will undoubtedly make them feel more fleshed out and add to that unique playthrough element that we think is one of EK's strongest points. 

[b]Cinematic CGs[/b]

Last but not least are the 'cinematic' CGs we're adding to the final showdown! The climax of EK is pretty dramatic, as you would (hopefully) expect from a high-fantasy tale, so we wanted to step away from our more simple love interest type portraits that you unlock via romancing, and added some exciting scenes, mostly action, that will definitely bring some more excitement to the grand finale of the game.

As always, we'd like to thank you for the patience and grace that you've shown us throughout this delay. We truly can't express how important it is when people actively support and encourage indie developers to take their time. I promise you that none of us want to delay releases, but at this point in time when the world is basically on fire and burnout as a result of that kind of stress is such a prevalent thing, having people applaud us for being kind to ourselves when it comes to our work is the most amazing thing. We'll continue to keep you updated as we progress and will never leave you in the dark, and the promise that you will most definitely see Errant Kingdom in 2022 is still one that we will stick to.  See you next time and don't forget to keep up with us on Twitter!

notes.title: Chapter Five Patch & Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Thank you so much to those who emailed with issues. We will be unable to reply to all of those that we received unless we think you have an issue that we haven't addressed with this patch, but we have implemented fixes for all reported sprite, background, and menu/text errors with the said patch. We've made the decision to disable the animated backgrounds with this patch until further notice as a few players were experiencing full game crashes or freezes and these backgrounds are the thing in-game that may very well be causing some of these issues with players with older machines. This also significantly reduces the size of the download for the time being. We wanted to just be cautious and do this while we investigate this issue further. Our backgrounds are still stunning while static, so we hope that this isn't something that will hinder your experience too much with this update! Please see the notes below for specific fixes. If you still experience crashes after trying this update please email us and we'll assist you. 

If you have any other issues not mentioned below please drop us an email at info@lunarisgames.com only. Having a proper trail of conversations on email is really beneficial to us as a small team and we will get back to you much quicker! 

[b]FIXES[/b]

- At the end of the chapter the game was not exiting to the title screen (this is now fixed, but for future reference, if you ever have a freeze situation, you can try pressing the backspace key which will bring up a load/title menu).

- Ambassador Erik route leading into Maja x Erik poly: Corridor background was not hiding during the final scene and prevented players from being able to see the final CG.

- SPRITES: Maja switching outfits mid-scene in some routes. Lucien sprite not hiding after the scene in their bedroom in Ambassador. 

- During the Erik & Roux scene in the Knight route one of the menus was displaying option #1 regardless of if #2 was selected.

- During the Prologue speech scene the lake background was displaying instead of the town square.

- Various text errors (repeated lines etc.) have been amended. 

- CG Galleries: Lucien Chapter Five CG and the Rai x Luci CG from an earlier chapter are now unlocking. STEAM ISSUE ONLY: Previously unlocked CGs were not unlocked, this is now fixed.

As always, thank you for your support and your patience.

notes.title: Chapter Five Update Notes
notes.content:
A new dawn after a strange night, and you don't wake alone. It's time for your paths to converge under the watchful eye of the Gods.

It's here! Thank you so much for your patience waiting for this chapter! It's been a rough end to 2020 but we're excited to bring you this HUGE update. We've now branched off into our TWENTY SEVEN different possible routes, including no romance and poly romances! We really hope you enjoy. 

UPDATE NOTES (PATCH COMING MONDAY 04/01)

We are aware of a few minor issues (as below) that we'll be patching out early next week. None of these are game-breaking but require a little extra time to fix. If you encounter any issues that aren't listed below please email us with as much information as possible, including your system specs, on info@lunarisgames.com and we'll get back to you as soon as we can, but please bear with us as we have just one person answering all business emails! 

- Small slice gap at the top of CGs where the background is visible 

- Lucien CG gallery having some unlocking issues (certain CGs may not unlock. Too hot to handle? Maybe.) 

- Windowed mode stuck in one resolution. We're working on ensuring this is resizeable! 

-  In AMBASSADOR for the Maja x Erik poly route accessed via the Erik solo route, the 'Corridor' background doesn't despawn, causing it to block the final CG which subsequently freezes the ability to end the chapter

- When two sprites appear on-screen they may ~fly or ~dance into positions. This is not on purpose despite how cool it might look. 

THANK YOU, Happy New Year, and enjoy x

notes.title: Chapter One Is HERE!
notes.content:
[b]As well as our new dialogue indicators (which you can learn about in options) we now have our Codex! Unlock entries as you play each route and find them in our ‘Extras’ board in the main menu!
[/b]

[u][b]UPDATE 04/13 - NOTES[/b][/u]

We have a few minor known issues that are present in the release of Chapter One but that are by no means 'game-breaking'. Please only email us with issues that are not listed below on kris@wtncgame.com and we'll get back to you ASAP!  

- BUG: Narrative/Story Log will sometimes show as blank; This is a known Unity bug where scrolling is not working for some users. We have raised a ticket with Unity for assistance and will fix as soon as we know how. 

- BUG: Incorrect MC Role showing on save screen; your save files may display the incorrect role before your character name when saving. This is a random bug we're trying to isolate and find the root cause so we can fix, so please email us if you have this issue! Your save game will still load the correct route. 

- In-Development: We're still working on implementing saving during menus/choices so please bear with us on that! We'll have it ready as soon as we're happy with it.

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
We've just issued a small patch which will hopefully fix the frame rate/lag issues and the 'cursed text' glitch that a number of players have encountered.

Your feedback is always appreciated so if you are still encountering these issues (slow CG scrolls, dialogue lagging) then please email us on kris@wtncgame.com with the subject 'Steam Issues' and a small summary of your computer specs so we can investigate. 

Please note that the narrative log is still in beta phase and we will be implementing an update to this with the release of Chapter One in early March. 

Thank you!
